cases.proposal: Build a standalone inspectable evidence-lineage product for claims, sources, contradictions, corrections and unknowns.

world_evidence.description: THR had concrete pressure cases requiring source-dependence, translation/attribution and unresolved-identity distinctions.
world_evidence.evidence_ref: COM PR #376 + frozen THR interoperability fixtures

hard_cases.description: dependent repetition must not become independent corroboration
translation and attributed source criticism must remain bounded
reported distinctness must coexist with unresolved identity

candidates.evidence: Unmodified alsoleg89/doubt v0.8.0 validator pinned in COM PR #376.

review_losses.description: Dedicated THR ancestry/reported-state/supersession semantics are compressed in Doubt's smaller contract.

cases.proposal: Build a compiler/evaluator that preserves unresolved, refused, withheld, non-authority, conflict and revocation states through machine policy/negotiation.

world_evidence.description: A deliberately preserving compiler reproduced fixture-authored semantic states; this was not a real pipeline failure.

hard_cases.description: unresolved must not silently become negotiable
refusal must not become missing/default permission
withheld value must not be disclosed or inferred
revoked authority must not remain active

candidates.evidence: DPV/ISO 27560, XACML, Cedar, ODRL and current agent-authorization work preserve substantial status/reason/context/delegation semantics.

smallest_probe.description: Run current model/compiler against synthetic fixtures.
smallest_probe.kill_condition: Kill if fixtures mostly measure explicit cue-following or no real pipeline failure is observed.

cases.proposal: Build a tiny public-surface checker for contradictory lift-existence/currentness statements.

world_evidence.description: HIR, IRL and DSY had passenger summaries saying no lifts while another current owner-controlled public surface necessarily evidenced lift existence; BIW, AGV and LLE served as controls.

hard_cases.description: owner system should present lift existence consistently
owner system should present lift existence consistently
owner system should present lift existence consistently
existing-lift control should remain consistent despite separate outage information

candidates.evidence: National Rail Accessibility Map/live lift data and station/operator passenger/accessibility surfaces are the current owner system for the underlying information.

smallest_probe.description: Public six-station existence/currentness consistency checker with explicit fetch/negation guards and owner-routable output.
smallest_probe.kill_condition: Kill or shrink if the owner fixes the data, current public fetches become too fragile, or an existing owner tool provides the same consistency check.
